$comment: Layer 4 - claims this repository cannot prove on its own: a physical device, a simulator run, the EAS server-side environment store. Each entry is a written, checked-in statement of what a human observed, with a date, an expiry, and the recipe to observe it again. A governed document points at one with <!-- vt-claim: attested <id> -->. An entry past its budget FAILS the gate, and so does an entry no document references. Device claims are NOT auto-detected from prose: the marker is how such a claim enters the ledger (see scripts/verify/scan.js for why a heuristic was rejected - it produced four false alarms out of six matches on this repo's own docs).
